comment: Time trials (GDD pillar 5: instant restart, ghosts, medals; TECHNICAL §12 builds leaderboards on this in Phase 6). A trial unlocks when its mission is completed and runs in its region: the player is placed at `start`, a countdown holds him still, the clock runs until he is inside the `finish` trigger. `line` is the layout path used to compare progress with the best run's ghost. Medal times in seconds (a clean sprint of the race line takes 12.7 s; Adi runs it in 15.7 s).
